title: Everything I Know About E-Ink Phones in 43 Minutes 11 Seconds
description:
If you’re thinking about an E-Ink phone (or a phone-sized E-Ink reader), this video is my honest ranking from #10 to #1 after living with a bunch of them.

Some of these are brilliant “reading in your pocket” devices. Some claim to be minimalist phones but end up feeling like unfinished Android experiments. And a couple actually get close to replacing a normal phone — depending on what you need day to day.

I’ll explain what each device is good at, what will annoy you, and who I think each one is for — including the budget picks, the “proper phone” contenders, and the one I’ve ended up using the most.

Devices discussed include: Light Phone 2, NXT/XT e-ink X4, Moaan InkPalm, Minimal Phone, Mudita Kompakt, Bigme HiBreak (S/Pro), Boox Palma 2 / Palma 2 Pro, and V-(Woods) readers.

Here it is, the top ten e-ink phones! Let me know what you think of my list and whether you would rank them differently!

#minimalisttech #minimalphones #digitalminimalism
